units.text: Gaston Day publishes Middle School curriculum as per-grade subject strands rather than as named, individually-described courses. The rows below are those strands as the school states them.
90 course entries across 9 departments — 17 Advanced Placement, a named Bible course for each of the four years, and a Restoration & Sustainability department, which is rare.
